responsibility: Exports the user-facing AltiVec C/C++ interface for PowerPC targets with vector support. It enforces -maltivec availability, defines keyword compatibility macros, includes the generated rs6000 vector builtin declarations, and layers synonyms, overload helpers, predicate wrappers, and compatibility aliases over backend builtins so source code can use the standardized vec_* API across AltiVec and VSX extensions.
same_name_distinction: This is the public language interface half of the altivec pair: a user include file that defines AltiVec keywords, aliases, predicates, and builtin-facing API wrappers, whereas altivec.md contains backend RTL instruction patterns.
